  FROM main.Dimension.City
)
SELECT
  s.checksum AS staging_checksum,
  t.checksum AS target_checksum,
  (s.checksum = t.checksum) AS checksums_match
FROM staging_hash s, target_hash t

queries.description: Checksum comparison: main.Integration.Transaction_Staging vs main.Fact.Transaction
queries.sql:
WITH staging_hash AS (
  SELECT SUM(HASH(COALESCE(CAST(Bill To Customer Key AS STRING), ''), COALESCE(CAST(Customer Key AS STRING), ''), COALESCE(CAST(Date Key AS STRING), ''), COALESCE(CAST(Is Finalized AS STRING), ''), COALESCE(CAST(Outstanding Balance AS STRING), ''), COALESCE(CAST(Payment Method Key AS STRING), ''), COALESCE(CAST(Supplier Invoice Number AS STRING), ''), COALESCE(CAST(Supplier Key AS STRING), ''), COALESCE(CAST(Tax Amount AS STRING), ''), COALESCE(CAST(Total Excluding Tax AS STRING), ''), COALESCE(CAST(Total Including Tax AS STRING), ''), COALESCE(CAST(Transaction Type Key AS STRING), ''), COALESCE(CAST(WWI Customer Transaction ID AS STRING), ''), COALESCE(CAST(WWI Invoice ID AS STRING), ''), COALESCE(CAST(WWI Purchase Order ID AS STRING), ''), COALESCE(CAST(WWI Supplier Transaction ID AS STRING), ''))) AS checksum
  FROM main.Integration.Transaction_Staging
),
target_hash AS (
  SELECT SUM(HASH(COALESCE(CAST(Bill To Customer Key AS STRING), ''), COALESCE(CAST(Customer Key AS STRING), ''), COALESCE(CAST(Date Key AS STRING), ''), COALESCE(CAST(Is Finalized AS STRING), ''), COALESCE(CAST(Outstanding Balance AS STRING), ''), COALESCE(CAST(Payment Method Key AS STRING), ''), COALESCE(CAST(Supplier Invoice Number AS STRING), ''), COALESCE(CAST(Supplier Key AS STRING), ''), COALESCE(CAST(Tax Amount AS STRING), ''), COALESCE(CAST(Total Excluding Tax AS STRING), ''), COALESCE(CAST(Total Including Tax AS STRING), ''), COALESCE(CAST(Transaction Type Key AS STRING), ''), COALESCE(CAST(WWI Customer Transaction ID AS STRING), ''), COALESCE(CAST(WWI Invoice ID AS STRING), ''), COALESCE(CAST(WWI Purchase Order ID AS STRING), ''), COALESCE(CAST(WWI Supplier Transaction ID AS STRING), ''))) AS checksum
  FROM main.Fact.Transaction
)
SELECT
  s.checksum AS staging_checksum,
  t.checksum AS target_checksum,
  (s.checksum = t.checksum) AS checksums_match
FROM staging_hash s, target_hash t
